name: Grid Brush Demo
description: What a VR grid stroke actually is: small and local. A 16x16 floor with a handful of strokes, each at most 4x4 cells (the VR cap), centred where you point — raise 4x4, randomize 3x3, fill 2x2, add 1x1, checker 4x4, erase 2x2 — with one glowing 4x4 brush footprint marking the max stroke. The Grid tab applies GridOps only through GridOps.brush_cells/stroke (capped 1..4), never whole-grid.
theoreticalGrounding: In VR you tend what you can reach; the brush is capped at 4x4 so editing stays local, legible, and around-you.
